speaker: TOURISM ASSOCIATION
text: The wind turbines are already affecting coastal tourism.

speaker: TOURISM ASSOCIATION
text: Visitors come here for natural scenery and untouched coastlines.

speaker: TOURISM ASSOCIATION
text: We are concerned that additional visual modifications to the turbines may make matters worse.

speaker: TOURISM ASSOCIATION
text: Several local businesses already fear declining visitor numbers.

speaker: GOVERNMENT REPRESENTATIVE
text: The Ministry must balance environmental protection with economic stability.

speaker: GOVERNMENT REPRESENTATIVE
text: Every mitigation measure carries consequences for another sector.
